purpose: The one tracked specification of OntoKin's local development environment. tools/bootstrap_local.py and tools/doctor_local.py read it. It adds no package, package manager or runtime dependency beyond the adopted files it names, and it states no machine-specific path.

interpreter.statement: Development uses this exact patch. Other Python versions are not claimed as tested unless they were executed; pyproject.toml keeps requires-python >=3.11.

environment.statement: Each checkout or worktree has its own ignored environment, created in place and never copied between locations. Project commands run through its own interpreter.

core.purpose: Edit source and run standard-library reference work. Not sufficient for the complete test suite.
contents: Optional editable install of the checkout, which proves nothing about the installed package

readiness_checks.interpreter: The environment exists in this checkout and runs the exact implementation, version and distribution named above on a supported platform.
readiness_checks.isolation: The environment is a real directory of this checkout, is isolated from system site-packages and was created at this location.
readiness_checks.git: Git is available and the root is a Git checkout.
readiness_checks.source-import: The environment interpreter imports the ontokin source package from the checkout.

python-verification.purpose: The normal readiness target: the complete Python test suite and the Agent/0.5 and native-reader verification roles.
contents: A hash lock valid for the platform

readiness_checks.lock: A committed lock matches this platform and Python series and agrees with the pins.
readiness_checks.packages: Each pinned package is installed at exactly its adopted version.
readiness_checks.imports: Each pinned package imports in the environment.

visual-verification.purpose: Exporter or viewer work and the --full checks. Prepared only when it is selected.
contents: The npm dependencies of tools/package.json, installed from tools/package-lock.json
Playwright's matching Chromium headless shell, prepared as a separate step

readiness_checks.node: Node.js of the target major version is available.
readiness_checks.npm-dependencies: Each pinned npm dependency is installed at exactly its committed version.
readiness_checks.chromium: The Chromium headless shell that the installed Playwright expects is present.

package-smoke.purpose: Prove installed-package behaviour outside the checkout. Established only by running it.
contents: A clean build environment in a new directory
The wheel built from an identified source revision

readiness_checks.clean-build: The wheel is built in the clean build environment and its tool versions are recorded.
readiness_checks.clean-install: The wheel is installed into the separate clean environment.
readiness_checks.outside-run: The installed entry point runs from outside the checkout with source-path injection removed.

historical-native.purpose: Historical and native experiments. Each is prepared only by its own selected task under its own contract.
contents: The exact interpreter, application, binary, importer and input bindings that the owning contract names

readiness_checks.owning-contract: Established only by the contract of the selected experiment. General setup neither prepares nor accepts it, and a newer interpreter never inherits an old qualification.

linux-container.purpose: An optional later Linux reproduction profile. No container configuration is committed; native is the default and Docker is not required.

readiness_checks.adoption: A later profile must state its purpose and carry its own acceptance. An emulated amd64 container is never native Linux qualification.
